objectDescription: Save toolbar of the native Studio inspector: one Save action publishing saveChanges over the TableIO link to the form it sits with, which commits the edited row to its data source — the server-side materializer validates the document before anything lands. toolbarKey names this object because a toolbar renders the instances of the object its key points at (issue #17, step 2).

attributes.label: Save
attributes.tooltip: Save the changes of this tab
